fields.label: Print Format
fields.description: html: renders the HTML template in a browser print dialog. zpl: sends raw ZPL commands to a label printer.

fields.label: Weighted
fields.description: Enable weight-entry workflow for this label type (e.g. deli / fresh items sold by weight).

fields.label: Columns
fields.description: Number of label columns per printed sheet row.

fields.label: HTML Template
fields.description: Jinja2 template rendered server-side. Available context variables: item (all item fields), barcode (primary barcode string), price (formatted string), price_per_unit (string or null), label_type (this document).

fields.label: HTML Body Template
fields.description: Jinja2 HTML fragment placed inside <div class="label">. Use {{ item.item_name }}, {{ barcode }}, {{ price }}, etc.

fields.label: Custom CSS
fields.description: CSS injected into the print popup alongside the label dimensions. Scoped to .label { width: <width>mm; height: <height>mm; } by default.

fields.label: ZPL Template
fields.description: Jinja2 ZPL template rendered server-side. Same context variables as the HTML template.

fields.label: ZPL Template
fields.description: Full ZPL command string with Jinja2 expressions. Example: ^XA^FO50,50^ADN,36,20^FD{{ item.item_name }}^FS^XZ
